name: Dictators Files: The Dark Side of Power

episodes.title: WHO TURNED STALIN INTO A GOD? The Propaganda Machine Behind the Dictator
episodes.description:
How did Joseph Stalin transform himself from a party leader into the unquestionable father of the Soviet Union? Behind his image stood an enormous propaganda machine: editors, historians, writers, filmmakers, artists, and officials who rewrote history, manufactured heroes, erased political enemies, and turned Stalin into a figure of almost divine authority. But Stalin was not simply the passive beneficiary of their work. He personally edited books, altered historical narratives, and carefully controlled the image presented to millions.

From the famous photograph of a little girl in his arms to the millions of copies of the Short Course, from Stalin's carefully constructed film image to the removal of his body from Lenin's Mausoleum, this documentary investigates who built the cult, how it worked, and what happened when the Soviet Union finally tried to dismantle it.
